title: The store's gap list names only rows a model made, and Claude's routing labels carry its API thinking summary
request: The owner: fix the misleading gap list (about 460,000 rule and classifier examples reported as having no reasoning and no note) and the agents never captured; then, mid-turn: use Claude's thinking to add the reason, exactly the summarized thinking.
spec: A row no model made gets the note saying so and leaves the gap list; a row a model made, or whose maker the record does not name, stays a gap. Claude's silver routing labels get their reason from the labeller exchange's API thinking summary (thinking enabled, display summarized), never from a field asked for in the reply.
plan: Find where the coverage report counts examples without reasoning
One function saying why a row needs no thinking, used by the per-set counts and by the coverage report
Attach the labeller's kept thinking summary to Claude's routing labels by request id
Stop the labeller prompt asking for a reason in the reply
Look at why workspace chat, team, campaign and twin have no captured run with thinking
Tests, the scripted agent and harness suites for the changed prompt, record, commit

decisions.decision: Derive the note from the row's own answerers at count time, not a new contract field
decisions.why: decision, episode, judged and retrieval examples have no no_reasoning field; adding one is a dclab_core version change for a note the counts can read from who answered

decisions.decision: Who needs no thinking: rule, classifier, person and student answers; validator, measured, test and person judges; job, walk and stages episodes; code search; measured experiments; routing rows no model read
decisions.why: none of them is a model that thinks; the owner cancelled the reasoning backfill, so nothing is owed but the note

decisions.decision: Graph moves, team walks, DCLab Code steps and model-role answers without reasoning stay gaps
decisions.why: a model made them, or the record does not say who did: their missing thinking is a real gap

decisions.decision: Claude's label becomes a shadow reading (answerer routing_labeler, never used) carrying the exchange's thinking summary
decisions.why: the chat export already takes an answer's reasoning from a model reading with the same value and a kept summary; readings are never in the prompt, and the table and counts skip the labeller so it is never read as Home's own model

decisions.decision: No new Claude calls to explain rule rows
decisions.why: Claude explaining a rule's decision would be Claude's guess, not the rule's reason, and the owner cancelled that backfill on 2026-10-28

change: dclab_rnd/store/sets: why_no_reasoning and a no_model class in reasoning_counts; store/coverage: a no_model column, gaps only for rows a model made; store/layout: labels(name); store/sets/routing: the labeller's exchange joined by request id as a shadow reading, label_thinking counted, the table's model column never the labeller; store/routing_labels: no reason field written; prompts/routing_labeler: the reply has no reason; the conversation eval's ledger was fixed earlier the same day (dclab_rnd.agent_eval.home.conversation).

findings.defect: The gap list said about 460,000 examples had no reasoning and no note
findings.scenario: m1, m2, m3, m6, m7 and m8 rows answered by rules, classifiers, people, validators, measurements or code were counted as missing reasoning
findings.cause: the count read only reasoning fields and notes; rows no model made carry neither
findings.fix: why_no_reasoning gives those rows their note; the gap list names only rows a model made

findings.defect: Claude's 305 routing labels carried no thinking and a reason the reply wrote
findings.scenario: The labeller prompt asked for a reason field in the JSON reply, and the label file recorded thought false; the gateway had in fact kept a thinking summary for 271 of the 305 exchanges, joined to nothing
findings.cause: the prompt asked for reasoning in the reply (against the owner's rule) and the routing set never looked up the labeller's exchange
findings.fix: the prompt no longer asks for a reason; the routing set attaches the exchange's API thinking summary by request id

findings.defect: The routing labeller joined store paths by hand
findings.scenario: tests/test_store.py checks every store path is built by layout.py; routing_labels.py and the routing set built labels/ and sets/ paths themselves
findings.cause: the labels folder had no layout method

findings.defect: The research campaign never keeps its exchanges or asks for thinking
findings.scenario: 22 campaign calls on 2026-10-26 counted in the usage log, none kept as an exchange
findings.cause: the campaign calls the model through NOOA's own litellm client; the gateway only checks and counts it
findings.fix: open: needs the campaign routed through the gateway, or thinking passed and kept through NOOA, with a small live check

measurements.name: coverage gap list on the real store
measurements.gate: every remaining line names data a model made or a capture path that is missing
measurements.result: 34 lines before, 18 after; m1, m2, m3 and m6 keep 14,887 rows a model made or whose maker is unnamed
limits: the lines for agents never run stay until they run

measurements.name: Claude routing labels carrying their API thinking summary
measurements.gate: every silver label whose labeller exchange kept a summary carries it as the answer's reasoning
measurements.result: 271 of 305 exchanges kept a summary; 257 silver labels in the rebuilt sets carry it
limits: some labeller calls returned no thinking: adaptive thinking skipped easy cases

measurements.name: harness suite after the labeller prompt change
measurements.gate: 17 of 17 regression cases and dev journeys right on every step

measurements.name: scripted judgment suite after the labeller prompt change
measurements.gate: the suite runs on the new prompt hashes and stores its result

outcome: The gap list names what is missing; Claude's silver routing labels train with Claude's own summarized thinking as their reason. Workspace chat and team were never run; twin's and campaign's calls predate thinking capture; the campaign's path keeps no exchange at all, still open.
lessons: A count of missing reasoning must know who made the row: a rule has nothing to keep
Before asking a model again for its reasons, look for the thinking the gateway already kept
A third-party client that bypasses the gateway loses the exchange even when the cost is counted
risks: Rows from a future answerer kind not in the list are counted as gaps until it is added
34 of the 305 labels have no thinking: adaptive thinking skipped easy cases
